description: Empirical comparison of predefined two-camera audio-assisted temporal state policy vs fair single-camera and vision-only baselines on synchronized held-out events
scientific_limitation: Restricted to 27 single-crossing events (11 dual-camera synchronized); descriptive benchmark without cross-site generalization claim.

description: Role-differentiated visual evidence where front camera detects approaching train and rear camera detects departing train / tail clearance
intended_metric_or_endpoint: Viewpoint detection accuracy; approach onset T1; departure clearance T4
scientific_limitation: Lateral camera geometry starves rear viewpoint (only 1.4% rear detections); requires Rule 3C disappearance confirmation in Policy V2.

description: Measure contribution of second (rear/departure) camera over single-camera approach baseline
intended_metric_or_endpoint: Clearance detection latency; gate reopening safety; premature opening prevention
scientific_limitation: Full cohort not synchronized; valid shared-timeline dual-camera analysis strictly limited to 11 CALIBRATION_SUPPORTED events per Phase 12 decision.

description: Evaluate independent acoustic horn evidence as supporting closure modality and warning lead time booster without inflating false alarms
intended_metric_or_endpoint: Warning lead time; event recall; false alarm rate (episodes/hr)
scientific_limitation: Acoustic horn classifier evaluated against adopted event labels (54.5% prec 92.3% recall); operates strictly as supporting closure evidence (Rule 2)

description: Evaluate temporal evidence buffering and multi-frame consistency filtering vs independent per-frame decisions
intended_metric_or_endpoint: Event-level chattering reduction; false trigger rejection; state transition stability
scientific_limitation: Tested in synthetic battery S1-S10; 2-tick confirm and 2-tick drop rules eliminate single-frame spurious noise.

description: Prevent hazardous premature gate opening using asymmetric authority and positive departure confirmation
